column1: # The v0.6.2 slice line's backlog file (slice-line/README.md, "The backlog file"). Tab-separated; '-' for empty.
# build: the build id in the owner's plan (dashboard/index.html). A slice whose id is not in the plan is not started.
# after: slices that must be merged first. track: blank lets the line choose. env: none, or full (venv and node).
# acceptance_files, acceptance, checks: frozen when the slice starts; a change after that needs the owner's word.
# Commands run from the root of the slice's worktree (or of the merge result).
